/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('/tmp/spring_orders_result.json')
result = json.loads(source.read_text())
assert list(result) == ['total_cents', 'order_count', 'duplicates_skipped', 'by_region']
assert list(result['by_region']) == ['north', 'south', 'east', 'west']
assert all(type(value) is int for value in result.values() if not isinstance(value, dict))
assert all(type(value) is int for value in result['by_region'].values())
assert sum(result['by_region'].values()) == result['total_cents']

Path('/workspace/result.json').write_text(source.read_text())
print(Path('/workspace/result.json').read_text())
print('Workspace files:', [path.name for path in Path('/workspace').iterdir()])
